gear.farm: World Drop (Repair Kits) · Order-weighted epic pools
gear.purple_why: Order Epic always has 2 charges and rolls Primary + Secondary (e.g. Accelerator + Splash Damage). Legendary Triple Bypass uses the legendary perk slot for 3-charge/Heart Pump and only gets ONE secondary — so purple is the only way to run Accelerator and Splash/Elemental Affinity together before/until a god-roll Triple Bypass secondary drops.
gear.item_hint: Bridge / fallback purple — keep if Triple Bypass secondary is weak
priorities: Secondary: Splash Damage (Explosive) or Elemental Affinity (Reactive)
